title: source.rank input
description: Top-level request shape for source.rank. Each item of records and evidence is validated by the skill against source-record.schema.json and evidence.schema.json respectively, with one deliberate difference: the three timestamp fields (published_at, occurred_at, retrieved_at) are NOT required to be valid date-times, because an invalid or missing timestamp is a reportable condition for this skill rather than a rejection. Every other field is validated strictly.

account_id.description: Resolved account identifier (not a name or domain). Items for any other account are excluded and counted, never ranked.

records.description: Raw source records in the source-record.schema.json shape. Items are validated one by one; a malformed item is rejected and reported without failing the request. The source identifier is metadata.provider.

evidence.description: Normalized evidence items in the evidence.schema.json shape. Items are validated one by one; a malformed item is rejected and reported without failing the request. An item whose source_record_id matches a supplied record inherits that record's source identifier; otherwise its source_type is the source identifier.

now.description: Reference time for age_days. When supplied the skill never reads the system clock.
